title: Chat Manager
description: Staff can clear, stop, or resume global server chat instantly. It also includes a permanent system to chat-ban players, unban them, and view the muted list.
body:
# ChatManager

A lightweight, modern, and highly efficient chat moderation plugin. Take complete control over your server's communication channel, stop spammers instantly, and keep your community safe.

This plugin uses Paper's native **Adventure API**, ensuring smooth, asynchronous, thread-safe chat manipulation and full support for modern text formatting.

---

## Features

* **Clear Chat:** Instantly wipe the global chat history to hide malicious links, severe spam, or rule-breaking content.
* **Mute/Resume Global Chat:** Freeze the entire chat instantly during important announcements or server emergencies.
* **Permanent File-Backed Chat Bans:** Permanently chat-ban individual players. Mutes persist cleanly through server reboots and reloads via a local file (`config.yml`).

---

## Commands & Permissions

By default, all staff have access to the commands.

| Command | Description | Default Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/chat clear` | Wipes active chat. | `chatmanager.staff` |
| `/chat stop` | Halts global chat for non-staff. | `chatmanager.staff` |
| `/chat resume` | Unfreezes global chat. | `chatmanager.staff` |
| `/chatban <player>` | Bans a player from using chat. | `chatmanager.staff` |
| `/unchatban <player>` | Restores chat access for a player. | `chatmanager.staff` |
| `/chatbanlist` | Lists all currently chat-banned UUIDs/Names. | `chatmanager.staff` |

### Bypass Node
* **`chatmanager.bypass`**
  Give this permission to senior staff, administrators, or automated system accounts. Players with this permission node can still send messages even when global chat has been locked with `/chat stop`.

---

## Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar` file.
2. Drop it directly into your server's `/plugins/` folder.
3. Restart or start your server.
4. Configure permissions
